decision: Reject permanent P003-P007 weld as production baseline; use removable static-sealed joint.
requirements: No dynamic seal across containment boundary.
P003-P007 location independent of clamp fasteners.
P007 thin magnetic zone OD10/ID9.4 and downstream axial stations remain unchanged.

pilot.P003_male: Ø16 g6 x 1.50 protrusion; internal clearance bore ≥ Ø12.0

seal.type: static axial face O-ring; no dynamic motion
seal.candidate: 18 x 1.5 FKM75; FFKM option if measured-gas compatibility requires
seal.note: Same 1.5 mm cross-section / 1.20 mm face-gland compression philosophy already used at P016. Final compound and groove standard verification remain release items.

clamp.fastener: M3 x 8, A4-70, low-profile/button head, removable
clamp.P003_thread: M3-6H, full thread 5.0 min; tap drill depth 6.0 min
clamp.function: clamp only; pilot locates; metal-to-metal faces control O-ring squeeze
clamp.torque: OPEN until screw finish/anti-galling method and O-ring compound are frozen

assembly_sequence: Disconnect and slide P015 rearward off P007.
Withdraw P007 axially; no weld cutting.
P006 and internal follower/rod hardware become accessible.
Replace static O-ring at service unless procedure explicitly permits reuse.
Reassemble on pilot, seat metal-to-metal faces, tighten clamp screws in cross sequence.

analysis_impact.static_buckling: Previous P007 thin-shell results remain screening evidence because OD10/ID9.4 thin zone is unchanged; one final refresh is required after service flange CAD freeze.
analysis_impact.magnetic: Final FEMM sweep required after serviceable flange freeze because front 316L geometry near P015 changes; no real magnet purchase is required.
